Sample.evidence_source: The sample consisted of six men aged 25–52 years and four women aged 21–45 years.

Country.evidence_source: The participants in the study were selected, informed and invited to participate by psychology specialists at two emergency psychiatric units and one crisis resolution team.

Population.evidence_source: There were four inclusion criteria: (a) serious suicidality – after a suicide attempt, the interview was to take place 2 weeks after the attempt, at the earliest; (b) non-psychotic; (c) able to verbalize experiences; and (d) access to a therapist at least 2 weeks after the interview was conducted.
